title: Wire all new runners (214-249) into RunProfiles, assessment chains, and wizard depth triggers so they are reachable and not dead code
goal:
Tasks 214-249 each add a new runner, but most do NOT specify the RunProfile entry, assessment chain phase, or wizard trigger that makes the runner reachable. Without this wiring, runners are built but never called. This task wires every new runner into the correct profiles, chains, and wizard selection logic. For each new runner below, do ALL of the following: (A) Add a new RunProfile entry in api/app/services/run_profiles.py. (B) Add the profile to the relevant assessment chain phase in api/app/services/assessment_chain.py. (C) Confirm or add the wizard.js depth trigger that enables the profile. (D) Add the profile name to scripts/acceptance_harness.py PROFILE_TOOL_MAP so tests validate it.

## WIZARD.JS TRIGGER RULES (add to resolveExecutionProfile in wizard.js)

```
if depth == 'active':
  profiles += ['active-web-xxe-probe', 'active-web-xss-extended', 'active-web-ssrf-probe',
               'active-web-ssti-probe', 'active-web-http-smuggling', 'active-web-graphql-probe',
               'active-web-deserialization-probe', 'active-web-oauth-probe', 'active-web-jwt-probe']
if depth == 'active' AND auth_context:
  profiles += ['active-web-idor-bac', 'active-web-session-security', 'active-web-auth-flow',
               'active-web-client-state']
if depth == 'passive' or 'active' or 'full' (all web):
  profiles += ['passive-web-headers-security', 'passive-web-logging-probe', 'passive-web-vuln-components',
               'passive-crypto-audit']
if tile == 'internal-lan' AND depth == 'full':
  profiles += ['intrusive-credential-priv-esc-linux', 'active-lan-ssh-brute', 'passive-lan-network-capture']
```

## ACCEPTANCE HARNESS (scripts/acceptance_harness.py PROFILE_TOOL_MAP)
Add all new profiles to PROFILE_TOOL_MAP with their expected tool names for CI validation.
scope: Tasks 214-249 create runners without RunProfile entries or wizard triggers. Without this wiring task, all new runners are orphaned. This task is the mandatory integration step for every new runner created in the gap-closing sprint.
generation_reason: New runners 214-249 have no RunProfile entries, assessment chain assignments, or wizard triggers. This single task wires all of them to make them reachable.

inputs.prerequisite_backlog: All referenced runner tasks (214-249) should be implemented before this wiring task is promoted, OR this task can be promoted immediately after each runner is implemented to wire it in.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Only add RunProfile entries and chain assignments. Do not change runner implementations. Do not change approval gate logic.

success_criteria: Every new runner from tasks 214-249 has a corresponding RunProfile entry in run_profiles.py.
Every new RunProfile is assigned to at least one assessment chain phase in assessment_chain.py.
wizard.js resolveExecutionProfile includes new profiles for the correct tile+depth combinations.
acceptance_harness.py PROFILE_TOOL_MAP includes all new profiles.
Running an External Web + Active Scan wizard flow dispatches xxe-probe, xss-extended, ssrf-probe, headers-security, logging-probe, vuln-components.
Running an Internal LAN + Full depth dispatches ssh-brute, network-capture, priv-esc-linux.
No regression in existing wizard flow tests.
must_not_touch: Existing profile tool lists (add to, never remove from)

acceptance_criteria: All new runners reachable via wizard + correct tile + correct depth.
Wizard External Web + Active dispatches xxe-probe.
Wizard Internal LAN + Full dispatches priv-esc-linux.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the only active task.

out_of_scope: UI changes beyond wizard.js trigger rules
